svg.title: Lapidary Architecture
svg.desc: You reach Lapidary through the web UI, the Windows console, REST and the OpenAI-compatible API, or MCP clients. The backend resolves prompts, picks which AI answers, runs assistants with tools, keeps history, tests and memory, and runs pipelines through test, visual and adversarial gates before you accept. Models run on this PC or online; everything is stored in SQLite or Supabase.
svg.text: Prompt library + agent harness + Windows console + memory + gates
FastAPI on :8000 • FastMCP • the same services behind every door
a model never decides it is done • failures go back to the builder
• free on this PC, or online with your own key
picks per call from your policy and what is set up • falls back the other way • records which model answered and why
